Carnival Funfair Games.name: Carnival Games
Carnival Funfair Games.summary:
All the excitement of your favorite Carnival Games is inside! Up to 4 players can join the fun as your Wii Remote transforms into a sledgehammer to a frog flinger - and everything else in between! Win tickets, wacky wearables and amazing prizes.

If your ready for over 25 games of chance and skill that are sure to thrill, then welcome to Carnival Games.

Dance Dance Revolution - Winx Club.name: Dance Dance Revolution: Winx Club
Dance Dance Revolution - Winx Club.summary: A European-exclusive spin-off to the long-running Dance Dance Revolution series featuring characters from the animated series Winx Club.

Destroy All Humans! Big Willy Unleashed.name: Destroy All Humans! Big Willy Unleashed
Destroy All Humans! Big Willy Unleashed.summary: Big Willy Unleashed takes place before the events of Path of the Furon and after Destroy All Humans! 2. The game is set in 1975, 6 years after Destroy All Humans! 2.

Fort Boyard - Le Jeu.name: Fort Boyard, le jeu
Fort Boyard - Le Jeu.summary: Fort Boyard the TV show is now on Nintendo DS and Wii! Will you be able to challenge the 19 games to win the famous Boyard coins? The game features an adaptable level of difficulty and high-score saving for replayability.

Heathcliff! The Fast and the Furriest.name: Heathcliff: The Fast and The Furriest
Heathcliff! The Fast and the Furriest.summary: Alien cat-like creatures have spent an eternity travelling through space, looking for a new place to call home, and have landed just outside Heathcliff's hometown! They abduct Sonja, and demand Heathcliff win a racing challenge to get her back.

Intervilles - Le Jeu Officiel.name: Intervilles, le jeu officiel
Intervilles - Le Jeu Officiel.summary: Intervilles, le jeu officiel provides the atmosphere of Intervilles in your living room. But beware, Rosa the cow is not far and her favorite pastime is to drop the candidates! Live the show as if you were there! In competition with a friend, take on the 25 challenges of your favorite show with public acclaim. Action, falls and laughs in perspective!

Just Dance 2014.name: Just Dance 2014
Just Dance 2014.summary:
Just Dance 2014 is a dance rhythm game that has you match the choreography of an on-screen dancer to earn points for accuracy, using your motion controller for real-time movement tracking. Beyond single-player routines, it expands the experience with online multiplayer via World Dance Floor, where you compete simultaneously with others, plus Wii U and Xbox-style second-screen support that helps you manage routines, playlists, and performance from a companion device.
The update also adds spotlight-friendly On Stage modes, letting one player lead with others as backup dancers, along with AutoDance to record and share your gameplay and Karaoke for singing along to on-screen lyrics. For variety and fitness, it supports customized workout playlists, calorie tracking across modes, and more dances per track through alternate choreographies in categories like Just Sweat, Extreme, Battle, and Mash-Up.

Petz - Crazy Monkeyz.name: Petz Crazy Monkeyz
Petz - Crazy Monkeyz.summary: Care and play with up to 3 monkeys at a time. You can breed them and create your own looking monkey with his own personality. Watch them all interact together. Use the Wii remotes to take your monkeys all over your house and teach him some new tricks.

Taiko no Tatsujin Wii.name: Taiko no Tatsujin Wii
Taiko no Tatsujin Wii.summary: Taiko no Tatsujin Wii is the first Taiko no Tatsujin game released for Nintendo Wii. The game come in two favors: A bundle with the TaTaCon made for Wii console, or only the game itself.
